title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an electrifying 1982 show with a scorching Scarlet > Fire transition and tight second set, recorded in crisp CM quality.
ai_review.review: The concert is hailed as a high‑energy masterpiece, especially the blistering second set highlighted by the iconic Scarlet > Fire segue and packed performances of Eyes of the World, Good Times and CC Rider. Reviewers also rave about the crystal‑clear cassette‑master (CM) soundboard transfer, calling it “off the charts.” Overall the show is described as a flawless example of the band’s 1982 magic.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star and consistently praise both the musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and the recording quality (crisp CM transfer), indicating an outstanding show with excellent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp cassette‑master (CM) transfer; listeners describe the sound as “off the charts” with no noted dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set leading into an incendiary second set with seamless transitions, especially the famed Scarlet > Fire segue; overall pacing keeps the groove alive throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned in a possible Phil/Jerry switch show and praised for firing on all cylinders during the performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Reference to a Phil/Jerry switch, contributing to the “82 magic” and strong groove.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir fans are delighted; his rhythm guitar/vocals noted as part of the band’s full‑groove feel.
